verdict.rationale: GPU acceleration is a fair question for a local-LLM desktop app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions NVIDIA, AMD, CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, or any vendor-specific acceleration kernels. The only engine reference is that the API server is "powered by llama.cpp", which says nothing about GPU vendor backends.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels
